notes.title: Quadroids is part of Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Dear employees,

Welcome to the Steam NexT Fest 2024 February Edition! 
This is your new chance to become "Employee of the Month"!
 
The Quadroids Demo is available right now to deliver you the game concept. 

If you're strong enough to clear the demo, keep your eyes open, as a secret level, showcasing a latter stage, might show up...!

On top of that demo, Quadroids will feature extra features for streamers to play with their community: 

[list]
[*] [b]Twitch Plays Quadroids[/b]: Hand over control to your viewers, allowing them to manage one or more screens. For the ultimate challenge, let them take command of all four screens using commands like !top_left, !top_right, !bottom_left, and !bottom_right to guide the Quadroids through each part of the screen.
[*] [b]Volunteers![/b]: Players can actively participate by typing "!volunteer" in the Twitch chat. The next Quadroids to jump into the game will bear the name of the volunteer, creating a personalized and unforgettable gaming experience. Handle with care, as sacrificing these volunteers is not advised!
[/list]

We'll be live on Quadroids twice during the Steam Next Fest!

- Wednesday 8pm CET / 11am PT - Guillaume Crouzille, Game Developper, the brain behind all the mind-twisted puzzles!

- Friday 4pm CET - Maximilien, Brand Manager at Maximum Entertainment

See you there!
Quadroids Team

PS : If you're still reading this, here is a scoop for you: The game will launch this month... More information are coming really really soon...
